about: counting accuracy from the detected sacrum on real C-arm frames, from the detectors' own boxes; no level classifier anywhere
definition: ordinal from the detected sacrum = rank of the detected body along the spine axis moving away from the sacrum; truth ordinal likewise from the truth sacrum among truth bodies (name-free); one-to-one greedy matching in descending confidence at IoU >= 0.5 (tools/realxray_eval.sweep_matches, the matching of the contribution matrix and a1.json); a matched body is counted correctly when the two ordinals agree; counting is defined on a frame when truth has a sacrum and a sacrum was detected
interval: 2,000-resample bootstrap clustered by case (C-ArmLSpine case, DeepFluoro specimen, COBRA patient), percentile and BCa, seed 0
